name: obsidian-ocr-macos
description: Automatic OCR for images in Obsidian using macOS Vision framework

scripts.build:swift: cd swift-ocr && swift build -c release && cp .build/release/ocr-cli ../ocr-cli
scripts.build:all: npm run build:swift && npm run build
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
